name: The Fool
upright: Reveal the top card of each player's deck. You may place one of them. Remove the rest from the game.
reversed: Deal 5 damage to each player.

name: The Magician
upright: Place a card. You may reverse this card.
reversed: Draw 3, then discard 3. If you cannot do either, you win the game.

name: The High Priestess
upright: Name a card. Choose a player to reveal cards from their deck until they reveal the named card. If they do, put the revealed cards in their memory. Otherwise, that player shuffles.
reversed: Place any number of cards face-down. Each player may flip a face-down card face up at any time to activate it and silence it.

name: The Empress
upright: If The Emperor is on your spread, you win the game.
reversed: You may place a card from any player's memory, then silence it and reverse this card.

name: The Emperor
upright: If The Empress is on your spread, you win the game.
reversed: You may replace any other card on your spread with a card from any player's spread, then reverse this card.

name: The Hierophant
upright: Choose Wands, Cups, Swords, or Pentacles. Remove all cards that aren't of the chosen suit from the game.
reversed: Dismiss all Major cards. For each card dismissed this way, its player may place a Minor card from their hand to that position.

name: The Lovers
upright: Each player chooses to draw 2 or gain 5 life.
reversed: Each opponent must discard. If they cannot, deal 3 damage to them.

name: The Chariot
upright: Take a card and put it on your spread. You may reverse it. You cannot replace Major cards this way.
reversed: Remove all cards in a player's memory from the game.

name: Strength
upright: Deal damage to an opponent equal to half their life rounded down, then deal that much damage to yourself. This cannot reduce your life total to less than 1.
reversed: Choose any number up to 10. Deal that much damage to each player.

name: The Hermit
upright: You may dismiss this card to reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Major card. You may replace this card with it or draw it. Shuffle your deck.
reversed: Each player chooses up to 2 cards. Dismiss all other cards.

name: The Wheel of Fortune
upright: Flip a coin. If you win, gain 5 life and flip again. Repeat until you lose a flip.
reversed: Choose an opponent. Flip a coin. Deal 2 damage to the loser. The winner may flip again, doubling the damage dealt that flip. Repeat this process until the winner chooses not to flip.

name: Justice
upright: The player with the least life gains 5 life, then deal 5 damage to the player with the most life. If there is a tie, you choose.
reversed: The player with the greatest life gains 5 life, then deal 5 damage to the player with the least life. If there is a tie, you choose.

name: The Hanged Man
upright: Dismiss any number of cards on your spread. On this turn, whenever you place a card, you may place an additional card for each card you dismissed.
reversed: The next time a player's life total would be reduced to less than 1, it is reduced to 1 instead.

name: Death
upright: Place up to 3 cards. Deal damage to a player equal to 5 minus the number of cards placed.
reversed: Dismiss up to 3 cards on your spread. Deal 5 damage to a player for each card dismissed.

name: Temperance
upright: Deal damage to players who have more life than the lowest life total until all players have the same life total.
reversed: If you have the lowest life total among all players, increase your life total to the lowest life total among all other players.

name: The Devil
upright: Deal 3 damage to each opponent. Gain 1 life for each opponent damaged this way.
reversed: Remove all cards on your spread from the game. For the rest of the game, whenever you would place a card, you may pay 2 life to place a card from your memory instead.

name: The Tower
upright: Remove this card from the game. Shuffle all cards into their players' decks. Starting with you, each player places 2 cards and cannot replace cards this way.
reversed: Remove this card from the game, then flip all cards. Each player may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.

name: The Star
upright: Gain 3 life. If you have at least 10 more life than each opponent, you win the game.
reversed: Deal 2 damage to each player, then deal damage to each opponent equal to the damage you have dealt to them this turn.

name: The Moon
upright: Return all other cards to their players' hands and remove this card from the game. Starting with you, each player places 2 cards to any other player's spread.
reversed: For each card in an opponent's hand and spread, its player moves one card from their deck to memory.

name: The Sun
upright: If you have fewer than 5 cards in hand, you may draw until you have 5 cards in hand. You may draw to less than 5.
reversed: Deal damage to each player equal to the number of cards in their hand.

name: Judgement
upright: Dismiss all cards. For each card on an opponent's spread dismissed this way, deal 2 damage to that player.
reversed: Dismiss this card. Place up to 3 cards.

name: The World
upright: Put a counter on The World, then deal damage to each opponent equal to the number of counters on The World.
reversed: Put 7 counters on The World. If there are 21 or more counters on The World, reverse it.

name: Ace of Cups
upright: Look at the top card of your deck. You may put it on the top or bottom of your deck. Draw.
reversed: You may place a card face-down. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.

name: 2 of Cups
upright: Draw for each Cup on your spread. You may reverse this card.
reversed: Deal damage to an opponent equal to the number of cards in your hand.

name: 3 of Cups
upright: Activate each other card on your spread in any order.
reversed: Flip a card on your spread. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.

name: 4 of Cups
upright: You may place a card face-down. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.
reversed: Return all cards on your spread to your hand.

name: 5 of Cups
upright: Copy an effect that has activated this turn.
reversed: You may shuffle your hand into your deck and draw that many.

name: 6 of Cups
upright: Restart the turn from the Past. Remove this card from the game.
reversed: Copy an effect of either side of a card.

name: 7 of Cups
upright: Choose 2 cards on the same spread. That player chooses a card from among those. Dismiss that card.
reversed: Deal damage to a player equal to the number of cards in your hand.

name: 8 of Cups
upright: For each opponent, return a card on their spread to their hand. Dismiss this card.
reversed: Flip a card on your spread or place one face-down. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.

name: 9 of Cups
upright: You may end the turn and flip this card. You may flip it at any time to activate it and silence it.
reversed: Copy an effect of either side of a card.

name: 10 of Cups
upright: You may reveal any number of cards in your hand. Draw for each Cup you reveal and each Cup on your spread.
reversed: Dismiss this card. Return all cards to their players' hands.

name: Page of Cups
upright: Each player reveals the top card of their deck. You may draw.
reversed: You may place a card face-down. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.

name: Knight of Cups
upright: Copy an effect of either side of a card in your memory.
reversed: Choose a player. That player puts 3 cards from their deck into their memory.

name: Queen of Cups
upright: Name a card. Until your next turn, cards with the chosen name cannot be dismissed, removed from the game, or placed.
reversed: Return any number of cards from your memory to your hand, then discard that many.

name: King of Cups
upright: Each player may draw. Until your next turn, each player who draws this way may not damage you or dismiss cards on your spread.
reversed: Flip any number of cards on your spread. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.

name: Ace of Pentacles
upright: Deal 2 damage to yourself. The next time you place a card, draw 2.
reversed: Dismiss a non-Wand, non-Pentacle card.

name: 2 of Pentacles
upright: Deal damage to a player equal to the number of cards in their hand.
reversed: Exchange the positions of two cards. You may reverse them. If both cards are on spreads other than yours, draw.

name: 3 of Pentacles
upright: Choose a player to reveal their hand. Choose a card from it. That player discards that card.
reversed: Deal damage to each player equal to 5 minus the number of cards they have in hand. If the damage is negative, that player draws that many.

name: 4 of Pentacles
upright: Dismiss this card. Take a card and put it on your spread. At the end of your next turn, dismiss that card.
reversed: Deal 2 damage to any number of players, then those players each draw.

name: 5 of Pentacles
upright: Each opponent with a Major card or a Swords card on their spread discards.
reversed: If you have fewer than 2 cards in hand, draw until you have 2 cards in hand.

name: 6 of Pentacles
upright: Gain life equal to the number of cards you have in hand.
reversed: Each opponent may give you a card from their hand. Deal 3 damage to each opponent who doesn't.

name: 7 of Pentacles
upright: Put a counter on this card. You may dismiss this card. If you do, your life total becomes equal to 7 times the number of counters on this card.
reversed: Choose a player with at least one card in their hand. That player discards their hand, then draws that many minus 1.

name: 8 of Pentacles
upright: Copy an effect of either side of a card on another player's spread.
reversed: You may reveal a Major card or Pentacles card from your hand. If you do, place it.

name: 9 of Pentacles
upright: Until the end of this turn, whenever you place a card, you may draw.
reversed: Return any number of cards from your memory to your hand. Deal damage to yourself equal to the number of cards returned.

name: 10 of Pentacles
upright: Place a card from your memory.
reversed: Choose up to three cards from one player's memory and remove them from the game.

name: Page of Pentacles
upright: Reveal any number of cards from your hand. For each Pentacles card you revealed and each Pentacles card on your spread, deal 2 damage to a player and gain 1 life.
reversed: Choose up to 3 cards from your memory. For each chosen card, remove that card from the game and deal 1 damage to any player.

name: Knight of Pentacles
upright: You may place a card in your Future position. You may exchange its position with another card on your spread and reverse either card.
reversed: If you have fewer than 2 cards in hand, draw until you have 2 cards in hand.

name: Queen of Pentacles
upright: Move 3 cards from your deck to your memory. The next time you would place a card, you may place a card from your memory instead.
reversed: Deal 2 damage to a player, then gain life equal to the damage dealt this way.

name: King of Pentacles
upright: Dismiss all Major cards, then dismiss this card. For each card dismissed, its player may draw.
reversed: Dismiss all Minor cards. For each card dismissed, its player may draw.

name: Ace of Swords
upright: Choose Wands, Cups, or Swords. For each card of the chosen suit, deal 2 damage to its player.
reversed: Dismiss a card. Its player may place another card in its place.

name: 2 of Swords
upright: Choose a player. They may exchange the positions of any cards on their spread. If they do, they may reverse those cards.
reversed: Reverse all cards.

name: 3 of Swords
upright: Silence a card.
reversed: Prevent the next instance of damage that would be dealt to you.

name: 4 of Swords
upright: Exchange a card on your spread with a card on another player's spread. You may reverse those cards.
reversed: Deal 3 damage to the player with the most life. In the event of a tie, you choose which player.

name: 5 of Swords
upright: Dismiss this card, then dismiss any other card.
reversed: Choose another player. You and that player each draw.

name: 6 of Swords
upright: Dismiss a Wand.
reversed: Name a card. Cards with the chosen name cannot be dismissed until your next turn.

name: 7 of Swords
upright: Dismiss this card, then take any card and place it in this card's position. You may reverse it.
reversed: Reverse a card.

name: 8 of Swords
upright: Dismiss a card on the spread of the player with the most life. In the event of a tie, you choose.
reversed: Reverse a card.

name: 9 of Swords
upright: The next time you would place a card, you may dismiss a card instead.
reversed: Reverse a card.

name: 10 of Swords
upright: Exchange a card on your spread with a card on another player's spread. You may reverse those cards.
reversed: Shuffle up to 3 cards of your choice from your memory into your deck.

name: Page of Swords
upright: Choose a number from 0 to 3. Each player draws that many.
reversed: Silence a card on each player's spread.

name: Knight of Swords
upright: The next time you place a card, you may activate it and silence it.
reversed: Each player simultaneously chooses a number. Deal damage to each player equal to the number they chose. Dismiss a card on the spread of each player who chose the smallest number.

name: Queen of Swords
upright: Dismiss a card from each player's spread.
reversed: Name a card. Cards with the chosen name do not activate until your next turn.

name: King of Swords
upright: Dismiss all cards.
reversed: You may dismiss any number of cards on your spread. Each opponent dismisses that many cards on their spread.

name: Ace of Wands
upright: Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Until the end of this turn, whenever you place a card, you may place one of those cards and remove the rest from the game.
reversed: Dismiss a card on your spread and place a card.

name: 2 of Wands
upright: Until the end of this turn, the next time a you would deal damage, deal double that damage instead. This can stack.
reversed: Place a card. The next time you would place a card, do not.

name: 3 of Wands
upright: Deal 2 damage to a player if this card is in the Past position, 3 damage if this card is in the Present position, or 4 damage if this card is in the Future position.
reversed: Dismiss a Minor card. Its player reveals the top card of their deck. If it's a Minor card, they may place it in the same position.

name: 4 of Wands
upright: Dismiss this card, then place a card. Each player discards their hand then draws 3.
reversed: You may reveal any number of cards in your hand. Deal 2 damage to a player for each Wand you reveal and each Wand on your spread.

name: 5 of Wands
upright: Deal 3 damage to a player. Flip this card. You may flip a face-down card at any time to activate it and silence it.
reversed: Deal 1 damage to each opponent.

name: 6 of Wands
upright: Activate another card on your spread.
reversed: Silence a card on your spread.

name: 7 of Wands
upright: Until your next turn, whenever a card on your spread is dismissed, deal 5 damage to any player.
reversed: Discard a card. If you do, deal 4 damage to a player.

name: 8 of Wands
upright: Deal 3 damage to a player, then replace this card with one from your hand or deck. It does not activate until your next turn.
reversed: Dismiss a card. Until your next turn, whenever its player would place a card, they may place that card instead.

name: 9 of Wands
upright: Deal damage to a player equal to the total number of damage you've dealt this turn, plus 1.
reversed: You may remove a card from your memory from the game and return a card from your memory to your hand.

name: 10 of Wands
upright: Deal 3 damage to a player for each Cups card on their spread.
reversed: Deal 2 damage to a player for each Major card on their spread.

name: Page of Wands
upright: Exchange this card with another card. You may reverse either card.
reversed: The next time you would place a card, you may deal 5 damage to any player instead.

name: Knight of Wands
upright: You may replace this card with one from your hand and activate the new card.
reversed: Activate another card on your spread twice, then silence it.

name: Queen of Wands
upright: Choose Wands, Cups, or Pentacles. Dismiss all cards of that suit. Dismiss this card.
reversed: Until your next turn, the next time you activate a card, activate it an additional time.

name: King of Wands
upright: Deal 3 damage to each opponent.
reversed: Reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Until the end of this turn, whenever you would place a card, you may place one of those cards instead and remove the other from the game.
